cc:Work.dc:title: 02 persona selection
cc:Work.dc:description: Plain-language overview of the frozen 2-traveller/2-journey feature selection and 23 overlapping single-attribute groups. Rounded survey contrasts read from cohort_mode_shares.csv; complete profiles in S01_technical_cohort_profiles.
